source.text:
In Australia though while a number of people don't like the idea of LLMs, there really is an issue with water and electricity ... it's also no mystery and many would be aware what's occurring in the US, with big tech being well flushed taking the lion's share of the power at times and power prices being thrust upwards. Fewer here would be aware that in at least one region in the US - a local grid was told they've had to go shopping for power from elsewhere as their usual power supplier was now fully committed to a data centre company.

I expect that in reality water could be recycled, cooling towers if not using heat recapture so it wouldn't be a great issue once the data park was up and running - the area around Dalby can get awful dry, if there was no water recycling, I doubt it would be viewed as tenable. The noise is they will be aiming to use air cooling or some such ... that would be interesting to see pan out.
